title: 小六课文参照回填：借物与出行
instruction: 先阅读本套自有课文配套，再依据配套原句完成全部十题。每空一词，首字母已给；输入完整单词（含首字母）。配套随题可见，可自愿合上后练习，但本页不把它称为受控的延时记忆测验。未列出的表达暂标待复核。
source_notice: 主参照原教辅“根据课文内容、首字母已给、每空一词”的完整十句结构，原1/3/10文字及2/5/6/8页图共对应7/10；4/7/9课文对应、具体版次和正式键仍缺。这里另外编齐本套自有课文配套，不是补写原课文，也不以作者全输入升级源完整或gold。四段配套是作者编排选择，不据此称原卷只有四段；页面允许直接参照，未复现此前课堂教学、背诵或延时条件，不能当记忆能力/年级效度已验证。独立教研、学生、商用和生产未验证。

lessons.title: A. The club room
lessons.text: Our club room opens after lunch on Tuesdays. Members may borrow a ball for one day. The borrowing desk is at the front of the room. The balls stand in a wide basket. Before taking a ball, members write their names in the blue book. They return the ball to the same place the next day.

lessons.title: B. A visit to the theatre
lessons.text: Last Saturday, my sister and I went to a puppet show. I kept my ticket in a coat pocket. The theatre was across the river. We took the second bus after lunch. From the window, we could see the water and a line of small boats. The bus stopped near the theatre door.

lessons.title: C. The meeting place
lessons.text: A guide met us at the theatre. Walk for one minute from the bus stop. Then you will see a yellow door. Remember to bring your notebook. The guide wanted us to draw one puppet after the show. My sister brought a pencil for each of us.

lessons.title: D. Back at home
lessons.text: At home, I drew the fox puppet at my desk. The upstairs room was quiet that evening. I could hear the clock, but nobody was talking. My school bag was empty after I took out all the books. I put the drawing in it so I could show my friends the next day.
